title: Narrative Systems Engineering: Signal-Grounded Multimodal Metrics and State-Space Control Dynamics for Audiovisual Media
description:
Foundational research framework, mathematical formalization, and reproducible C#/.NET 10 multimodal computational engine originated by Jair Ivan Rojas Ruiz (ORCID: 0009-0003-1109-4583) for measuring, modeling, and simulating audiovisual narratives as coupled acoustic, visual, and linguistic signals u(t) acting on a bounded cognitive-social state space x(t+1) = f(x(t), u(t)).

Includes formal operationalization of the six core NSE metrics: Narrative DNA (signed entity-belief tripartite graphs), Narrative Entropy (Shannon bits), Narrative Energy (cross-modal prosodic-visual-linguistic resonance functional), Narrative Complexity, Narrative Inertia, and Narrative Controllability (discrete-time Controllability Gramian W_c), validated across a 3-work cross-domain benchmark corpus (EXP-001 and EXP-002).
notes: Originated, authored, and directed by Jair Ivan Rojas Ruiz (ORCID: 0009-0003-1109-4583). Repository: https://github.com/jaiborojas-cloud/narrative-systems-engineering
